entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: HUH? WHO THE HELL... ARE YOU TRYING[n]TO PICK A FIGHT WITH ME!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Here's another bossy-looking one...[n]Joker, let's work him over for some[n]info!

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: DO YOU HAVE SOME SORT OF[n]BUSINESS WITH ME?
It's actually with your chief.
Where is your chief?

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: OH, THE CHIEF...

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: IF YOU CAN EVEN CALL HIM THAT![n]HE CAN'T DO A SINGLE THING RIGHT!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Well! Sounds to me like he's got[n]some beef with the chief.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Joker, if you play him right, he might[n]dish some useful details!

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: ALL HE'S GOT IS HIS RANK! HE WALKS[n]AROUND ALL HIGH AND MIGHTY, BUT[n]HE'S NOT ALL THAT!

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: HE DOESN'T EVEN HAVE A CLUE THAT[n]I KNOW HIS WEAKNESS!
Wow, that's impressive.
Where is he already?

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: I KNOW, RIGHT? GLAD YOU AGREE!

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: ...YOU WANNA HEAR IT? THIS IS HUGE,[n]SO NO TELLING ANYONE ELSE, GOT IT?

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: THE CHIEF IS WEAK TO [clr 2]PSYCHOKINESIS[clr 27]![n]NOT EVEN HIS INDUSTRIAL-STRENGTH[n]PLATING CAN SAVE HIM FROM IT!

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: OH— MAYBE I SHOULD'VE KEPT[n]THAT ONE TO MYSELF...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Nice! A classic slip of the tongue!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I don't think he has any more useful[n]dirt, so let's just mop the floor with[n]him real quick!

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: AUGH, NO! WAIT, WAIT, WAIT!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Any boss that lets their employees[n]suffer deserves the same thing!

entries.speaker: Corporobo
entries.en: I HAVE NO CLUE. THE CHIEF'S WAY TOO[n]BUSY FOR ME TO GET AHOLD OF.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This guy's useless! Let's just put[n]him away real quick, Joker!
